svg.aria-label: Architecture at a glance. How the installed CLI composes the command runtime, shared semantics, host adapters, and publication APIs.
svg.title: Superbee architecture at a glance
svg.desc: The installed superbee package composes the reusable command runtime, host adapters, and capabilities. Those packages depend inward on core, which owns bundle semantics and storage contracts. The current stable package ships publication modules and built UI assets beside the CLI. The diagram groups ownership rather than enumerating every dependency.
